label.purpose: Identifiers, timestamps, ranges, chart labels, and tabular values.

motion.name: fast-state
motion.purpose: Short hover, focus, and control-state transitions; reduced-motion settings override it.

motion.name: standard-state
motion.purpose: Consistent state transitions for inventory rows and controls.

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: A compact search/filter input on a dark surface.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--color-subtle-foreground); font: 12px var(--font-mono); } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--color-control-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--color-foreground); background: var(--color-background); font: 500 14px var(--font-body); transition: border-color var(--motion-fast), background var(--motion-fast); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-focus); outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Node Inventory Row
components.description: An open, full-row link with compact node identity and status.
components.html: NODE / core-routerCore RouterOnline
components.css: .ds-node-row { display: flex; min-height: 92px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 20px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-soft); color: var(--color-foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: background var(--motion-standard); } .ds-node-row:hover { background: rgba(238, 233, 223, 0.035); } .ds-node-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-node-row small { display: block; color: var(--color-subtle-foreground); font: 11px var(--font-mono); } .ds-node-row strong { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font: 600 19px var(--font-body); } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 600 12px var(--font-mono); } .ds-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-online { color: var(--color-online); }

components.name: Status Labels
components.description: Text-led semantic status pills with a matching indicator dot.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 12px var(--font-mono); } .ds-status-pill i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status-online { color: var(--color-online); background: rgba(139, 197, 181, 0.09); } .ds-status-degraded { color: var(--color-degraded); background: rgba(227, 184, 91, 0.09); } .ds-status-offline { color: var(--color-offline); background: rgba(227, 143, 131, 0.09); }

components.name: Metric Period Selector
components.description: A compact segmented selector with an explicit selected period.
components.css: .ds-periods { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-soft); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-background); } .ds-periods button { min-width: 44px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--color-subtle-foreground); background: transparent; font: 13px var(--font-mono); transition: border-color var(--motion-fast), color var(--motion-fast), background var(--motion-fast); } .ds-periods button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--color-range-selected-border); color: var(--color-kicker); background: rgba(200, 165, 125, 0.12); } .ds-periods button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Simulated Data Label
components.description: Persistent copy that clarifies fixture data is simulated.
components.css: .ds-simulated { display: inline-flex; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(200, 165, 125, 0.2); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--color-kicker); background: rgba(200, 165, 125, 0.07); font: 11px var(--font-mono); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Metric Chart Panel
components.description: A measured line chart on a restrained graphite surface.
components.css: .ds-chart { margin: 0; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-soft); border-top: 2px solid rgba(200, 165, 125, 0.62); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-chart figcaption { margin-bottom: 14px; font: 600 14px var(--font-body); } .ds-chart svg { display: block; width: 100%; overflow: visible; } .ds-grid { fill: none; stroke: rgba(188, 183, 175, 0.14); stroke-dasharray: 2 5; } .ds-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--color-focus); stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: round; }

components.name: Peak Loss Annotation
components.description: A compact note linked to the measured maximum packet-loss point.
components.html:
Peak packet lossMaximum in selected period

See the timestamped sample in the table.
components.css: .ds-annotation { display: grid; gap: 7px; padding: 14px 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(200, 165, 125, 0.45); color: var(--color-muted-foreground); background: linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(200, 165, 125, 0.055), transparent 75%); } .ds-annotation span { color: var(--color-kicker); font: 11px var(--font-mono); } .ds-annotation strong { color: var(--color-foreground); font: 600 16px var(--font-body); } .ds-annotation p { margin: 0; font: 13px/1.5 var(--font-body); }

components.name: Recovery Button
components.description: A clear retry action with a measured copper boundary and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-retry { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-action-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--color-foreground); background: rgba(200, 165, 125, 0.12); font: 600 14px var(--font-body); transition: border-color var(--motion-fast), background var(--motion-fast); } .ds-retry:hover { border-color: var(--color-focus); background: rgba(200, 165, 125, 0.2); } .ds-retry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Measurement Table
components.description: An exact, horizontally scrollable textual alternative to the charts.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-soft); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-surface); } .ds-table-wrap table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--color-muted-foreground); font: 12px var(--font-mono); } .ds-table-wrap caption { padding: 16px 16px 4px; text-align: left; } .ds-table-wrap th, .ds-table-wrap td { padding: 11px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-soft); text-align: left; } .ds-table-wrap th { color: var(--color-subtle-foreground); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The dashboard treats network health as an evidence review: warm charcoal surfaces, paper-toned type, and restrained copper annotations organize fixture data without dressing it up as live telemetry. Sea-glass, amber, and coral are reserved for the three meaningful node states. The detail view follows “Evidence Margin”: node context stays compact, latency leads, and packet loss is paired with a concise maximum-value annotation.

The interface favors readable operational density over a marketing-style hero. Clear hierarchy, quiet rules, and precise labels keep the inventory and metric evidence scannable on desktop and mobile. Motion is limited to short state transitions; reduced-motion preferences are honored.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal, paper-toned text, and restrained copper accents.
Status colors communicate node health; chart accents identify measured series.
Simulated fixture data is identified in the interface.
Compact inventory rows and an evidence-led detail composition.

rules.name: The Fixture Truth Rule
rules.body: Never style simulated measurements or their labels in a way that implies live monitoring.

rules.name: The Measurement Mono Rule
rules.body: Reserve monospace for identifiers, addresses, timestamps, ranges, chart metadata, and tabular measurements; use the body face for prose.

rules.name: The Evidence Order Rule
rules.body: Keep node identity and status before metrics, latency as the leading chart, packet loss and its maximum annotation adjacent, and the exact sample table after the visual evidence.

dos: Do preserve the Applied Research Journal palette and the Evidence Margin reading order.
Do identify all fixture measurements as simulated and keep the exact sample table available.
Do use the status hues only for their matching node states and retain readable text labels.
Do keep focus outlines visible and preserve the 3:1 measured boundaries for filters, selected periods, and recovery actions.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences and the responsive breakpoints documented above.
donts: Don't claim live telemetry, persistence, uptime, alerting, or synchronization that the product does not provide.
Don't use copper as a node-health status or use status colors as general decoration.
Don't remove the table when changing chart presentation; it is the exact textual measurement alternative.
Don't treat decorative chart grid lines or soft separators as essential data marks or control boundaries.
